== Release date and checklist ==
The July announcement’s 1 August date was postponed. Decipher gives the revised 8 August retail date in [https://archive.org/details/youtube-aGuOdeGJ_78 Radio Free Decipher #89] at 11:21–11:28 and in [https://web.archive.org/web/20050427161528id_/http://www.decipher.com:80/starwars/expansions/coruscant/coruscantsealeddeck.html Coruscant Sealed Deck Tournaments]. [https://archive.org/details/youtube-BLjrDT1fFms Episode #91] at 0:58 confirms the release had occurred two days before its 10 August broadcast. San Diego Comic-Con and Gen Con hosted separate prerelease tournaments.

The [{{fullurl:Coruscant (expansion)|oldid=351274}} reviewed checklist] shows 193 playable faces from 189 playable cards, including four two-sided Objectives. The remaining seven items in the 196-card physical count are rules cards and checklists. The set page also links the 24 later foil reprints.
